name: Foods Grid — Aether Foods
html:
Three ingredients.
Endless mornings.

Everything we make starts from the same short list: air, water, and a house culture. What it becomes is up to the kitchen.

  • Whipped Base

    A butter-weight spread built for toast, laminated dough, and everything in between.

  • Baking Fat

    Creams, folds, and browns like the fat it replaces, in the recipes you already trust.

  • Frozen Base

    The mouthfeel of a cream-forward dessert, engineered to hold its structure at scale.

  • Pourable Fat

    Finishing oil for the pass — glossy, neutral, and stable under heat.

name: Manifesto — Aether Foods
html:
They see a smear of butter; we see a molecule with better manners. They see a drizzle of oil; we see a shortcut evolution never took. The spoon skating the surface of that dessert? It is tracing the edge of a food system about to turn over.

At Aether, we believe flavor and responsibility were never supposed to be opposites. The smallest ingredient can carry the largest promise, and the future tastes like something you already crave. Above all, we believe in a kitchen that makes more from less.

Field notes

Better coffee starts with better math

With eleven years of cupping and roasting behind us, we've written down every ratio, grind setting and pour pattern that actually moves a cup from good to memorable.

The Field Guide walks through dial-in for six brew methods, with our house settings for the grinders most people already own.

Get the guide

name: Roast Feature — Cartography Coffee
html:
How we roast

  • Sourced direct

    We buy from ten producers by name, not through a single importer, and we publish what we pay for every lot.

  • Roasted in small batches

    Every batch is under 40lbs, roasted to order and shipped within four days of hitting the drum.

  • Cupped every morning

    Our roasters cup each batch against the last three before it ships, so quality doesn't quietly drift.

  • Dialed in for you

    Every bag lists the grind setting and ratio our own baristas use behind the counter to brew it.

name: Story — Cartography Coffee
html:
2013, where it started

One roaster and a folding table

We opened Cartography's first roastery in a converted print shop with one 15kg roaster and a folding table for a cupping bar. Nine years later we roast for eighty cafés and ship direct to about six thousand houses a month, but the cupping bar is still folding.

They see melted butter; we see a supply chain rebuilt from scratch.

The spoon gliding across that ganache?

At Fondera, we think the next era of food belongs to people who can hold two truths at once: the plain pleasure of a good dessert, and the quiet complexity built underneath it. We're not interested in indulgence that costs the planet more than it gives back. We're interested in a world where the richest bite on the table also happens to be the lightest one to make.

name: Mission — Marrow

Mission

They see a curl of butter; we see a coastline of chemistry.
They see a pour of oil; we see a slow unmaking of the herd.
The spoon dragging through that ice cream?
It is carrying the weight of an entire dairy, replaced.

At Marrow, we believe the next chapter of eating belongs to those who can hold two truths at once: the small joy of a good bite, and the enormous shift inside one molecule. The future, arriving disguised as dessert. And above everything, a way of eating that asks the planet for less and gives your palate more.
